from typing import TypeVar, Iterable, Callable, Awaitable
T = TypeVar('T')
async def in_order(items: Iterable[T], step: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]], *, reason: str):
    _ = reason
    for item in items:
        await step(item)
async def in_order_steps(steps, *, reason):
    _ = reason
    for step in steps:
        await step()
async def unrelated(items, step, *, reason):
    del reason
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await step(item)
